decks.summary: Core Set Roland who kills enemies to discover clues with Machete, the .45 and Guard Dog, adding Evidence! and Working a Hunch; the first step of a cycle-by-cycle upgrade series.
The Revised Core starter rebuilt: Machete and the .45 for enemies, Magnifying Glass and Flashlight for clues, Barricade and First Aid for safety; with a partner it leans on enemy management.
Two-core-set Roland built to share a collection with four sibling decks: weapons, Beat Cop and Guard Dog to fight, Evidence! and Working a Hunch to turn kills into clues.
Core Roland running eleven skills as pumps: one weapon, Magnifying Glass and Beat Cop out early, then investigate when the room is clear and fight when an enemy shows up.
Dunwich-era Roland who adds Dr. William T. Maleson, Art Student and Laboratory Assistant as soak and treachery insurance, and Prepared for the Worst to find Machete; still kills for clues.
Level 0 Guardian/Seeker Roland who gets clues by killing: On the Hunt and Maleson steer the encounter deck toward enemies, and "Let me handle this!" pulls them off a Survivor or Mystic partner.
An earlier version of Sleuth Enforcer: level 0 Roland who kills for clues with Machete and the .38, Maleson and Shortcut for tempo, built to protect a Survivor or Mystic partner.
Ally-army Roland: Motivational Speech and Charisma field Beat Cops and Field Agents for skill boosts and soak, Hallowed Mirror and Trusted keep them healed, and Enchanted Blade does the fighting.
Carcosa-era Roland using Calling in Favors to replay Art Student and Maleson, Logical Reasoning for horror and Eureka! for draw, still turning each kill into a clue.
A Revised Core starter padded with skill icons so a missing asset hurts less: the .45, Knife and Beat Cop to fight, Magnifying Glass and Flashlight to investigate, Barricade to hold rooms.
